articles.title: ‘Protector Turns Predator?’ Coimbatore Cop Suspended for Harassing Law Student on Train
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Coimbatore: A police constable attached to the R.S. Puram police station has been suspended for allegedly sexually harassing a law college student aboard the Chennai–Coimbatore Intercity Express.

body.html:
Coimbatore: A police constable attached to the R.S. Puram police station has been suspended for allegedly sexually harassing a law college student aboard the Chennai–Coimbatore Intercity Express.

The accused, identified as Sheikh Abdullah, was travelling after completing security duty in Chennai. The incident reportedly occurred when the train was nearing Katpadi, where the woman, who was travelling alone, was allegedly harassed by the constable seated next to her.

In shock, the student recorded the incident on her mobile phone and later lodged a complaint with the Railway Police. Acting on the complaint, officials intercepted and questioned the constable at Arakkonam railway station.

Police sources said the video footage substantiated the allegation, following which a case of sexual harassment was registered. Considering the seriousness of the charge, senior officers ordered Sheikh Abdullah’s immediate suspension.

Authorities said strict departmental and legal action would follow. Further investigation is under way.

articles.title: ‘Celebrity’ Birthday Drama on Surat Road: Businessman Blocks Traffic, Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Surat: A video showing a local businessman blocking a busy road in Surat’s Dumas area to celebrate his son’s birthday has gone viral, triggering public outrage. The man, identified as Deepak Ijardar, is seen standing in the middle of the road with fireworks, forcing vehicles to stop.

body.html:
Surat: A video showing a local businessman blocking a busy road in Surat’s Dumas area to celebrate his son’s birthday has gone viral, triggering public outrage. The man, identified as Deepak Ijardar, is seen standing in the middle of the road with fireworks, forcing vehicles to stop.

In the footage, a car driver is heard honking for way, after which Ijardar allegedly points sky shots towards the vehicle in a threatening manner. Though the firecracker was not lit, commuters appeared visibly alarmed. He later burst fireworks into the air while traffic remained blocked.

Following complaints, Surat police registered a case against Ijardar under Section 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for obstructing traffic and bursting crackers in a public place. Police said such acts endanger public safety.

When questioned, Ijardar reportedly claimed he was a “celebrity” and said stopping traffic for five minutes was not a big issue, drawing further criticism online.

The incident has renewed debate over civic sense and disruptive public celebrations in cities.

articles.title: ‘140 kmph, Drugs, One Death — Yet Bail’: Vadodara Hit-and-Run Sparks Outrage #breakingnews
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Vadodara, December 22, 2025: The Gujarat High Court on Monday granted regular bail to Rakshit Chaurasiya (23), a law student accused in the Vadodara hit-and-run case, after he spent around nine months in judicial custody.

body.html:
Vadodara, December 22, 2025: The Gujarat High Court on Monday granted regular bail to Rakshit Chaurasiya (23), a law student accused in the Vadodara hit-and-run case, after he spent around nine months in judicial custody.

The accident occurred on the night of March 13, during Holi, when Chaurasiya allegedly drove at nearly 140 kmph under the influence of cannabis and codeine, ramming into two-wheelers near Muktanand Circle in Karelibaug. A 43-year-old woman, Hemaliben Patel, was killed, while seven others were injured.

Viral videos showing the accused shouting “Another round” after the crash had triggered public outrage.

Justice Nikhil S. Kariel granted bail on a personal bond of ₹1 lakh with one surety, noting that the investigation is complete, the chargesheet has been filed, and that punishment cannot precede trial. The court also referred to selective outrage in road accident cases.

The victims’ families expressed anguish over the order, calling it a setback to justice and road safety. The accused faces charges under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Motor Vehicles Act.

articles.title: 13 Killed in Early Morning Bus–Tanker Collision in Chitradurga
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chitradurga (Karnataka), 25 Dec 2025: At least 13 people were burnt alive in a horrific road accident near Gorlattu village in Chitradurga district on Thursday morning.

body.html:
Chitradurga (Karnataka), 25 Dec 2025: At least 13 people were burnt alive in a horrific road accident near Gorlattu village in Chitradurga district on Thursday morning. A Seabird Private Travels bus, en route from Bengaluru to Gokarna, collided with a lorry and a diesel tanker, triggering a massive fire.

The bus was carrying around 32 passengers at the time of the crash. Several passengers were trapped as flames engulfed the vehicle. Officials said 13 deaths have been confirmed so far, and the toll is feared to rise.

Rescue and relief operations are underway, and police have launched an investigation into the cause of the accident.

articles.title: Coal Stove Turns Killer: Five Painters from UP Die in Kurukshetra Hotel Room
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kurukshetra: In a tragic incident, five painters from Uttar Pradesh died due to suffocation caused by a coal stove in a room near the Sterling Hotel in Kurukshetra district, Haryana. The victims had arrived from Saharanpur just two days earlier for a painting contract.

body.html:
Kurukshetra: In a tragic incident, five painters from Uttar Pradesh died due to suffocation caused by a coal stove in a room near the Sterling Hotel in Kurukshetra district, Haryana. The victims had arrived from Saharanpur just two days earlier for a painting contract.

The deceased have been identified as contractor Noor (30), his brother Sonu (28), Roshanpal (45), Roshanpal’s brother-in-law Ramkumar (42), and Madan Pal (40), all residents of Sheikhpura Qadeem area. They were staying in staff rooms built near the hotel.

Police said the deaths occurred between 12 am and 2 am on Tuesday. Sector-7 outpost in-charge Kamal Kumar said an accidental death report has been registered. Forensic expert Dr Naresh Saini confirmed that the cause of death was carbon monoxide poisoning from the coal stove.

Sonu reportedly showed signs of movement, suggesting he tried to get up, but could not survive. Postmortem was conducted and the bodies were handed over to the families.

The incident has plunged their villages into grief. Noor had been married just four months ago, while Madan Pal was the sole breadwinner of his family. Roshanpal and Ramkumar’s deaths have dealt a double blow to their relatives.

Police are investigating the circumstances under which the stove was used in the closed room.

articles.title: KGMU ‘Love Jihad’: Resident Doctor Accused of Sexual Exploitation, Forced Conversion, Blackmail
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lucknow: An FIR has been registered against a resident doctor of King George’s Medical University (KGMU) for allegedly sexually exploiting a fellow MD student, forcing her to convert to Islam, and blackmailing her with private photos and videos on the false promise of marriage.

body.html:
Lucknow: An FIR has been registered against a resident doctor of King George’s Medical University (KGMU) for allegedly sexually exploiting a fellow MD student, forcing her to convert to Islam, and blackmailing her with private photos and videos on the false promise of marriage. The accused has been identified as Dr Ramiz Uddin Naik, MD Pathology resident.

According to the complaint, Ramiz befriended the woman, claimed he was unmarried and established physical relations by promising marriage. She later learnt that he was already married and living in Thakurganj, Lucknow. When she insisted on marriage, he allegedly made religious conversion a condition and threatened to make her private content viral.

The victim also alleged that she became pregnant in September and was forced to undergo a medical abortion. Under severe mental distress, she attempted suicide on December 17 by consuming sleeping pills and was saved after being rushed to a trauma centre.

Police said the case has been registered under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for sexual exploitation, cheating, criminal intimidation, abetment to suicide, and under the Uttar Pradesh Prohibition of Unlawful Religious Conversion Act. The accused is absconding.

KGMU authorities have suspended Dr Naik with immediate effect and barred his entry into the campus pending investigation.

articles.title: Hyderabad Hit-and-Run: Speeding Car Knocks Down Woman on Scooter in Manikonda, Case Registered
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A hit-and-run case has been registered in Hyderabad’s Manikonda area after a speeding car collided with a woman riding a scooter and fled the spot without stopping.

body.html:
A hit-and-run case has been registered in Hyderabad’s Manikonda area after a speeding car collided with a woman riding a scooter and fled the spot without stopping.

According to the police and CCTV footage from the area, the woman was crossing the road on her scooter when the speeding car rammed into her. The impact threw her into the air before she fell hard onto the road. Despite the collision, the car did not stop and sped away from the scene.

The incident has once again raised serious concerns over road safety and reckless driving in the city. Police have registered a case and are analysing CCTV footage from nearby cameras to identify the vehicle and trace the driver involved in the hit-and-run.

Further details about the condition of the injured woman are awaited, while authorities have appealed to the public to share any information that could help in tracking down the accused.

articles.title: Bail for Kuldeep Sengar Sparks Fear, Victim Says “Powerful People Will Still Threaten Us”
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Unnao rape survivor has expressed deep anguish after the Delhi High Court granted bail to former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar, who is serving a life sentence in the case.

body.html:
The Unnao rape survivor has expressed deep anguish after the Delhi High Court granted bail to former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar, who is serving a life sentence in the case. While suspending his sentence until the hearing of his appeal is completed, the court ordered that Sengar will continue to remain in custody for now.

A bench of Justices Subramonium Prasad and Harish Vaidyanathan Shankar passed the order on December 23, imposing strict conditions. As per the court, Sengar will not be allowed to leave Delhi during the bail period, cannot go within a five-kilometre radius of the victim’s residence, must surrender his passport, and will have to report to the local police station every Monday. Any violation will lead to cancellation of bail.

The victim, who was present outside the court when the verdict was announced, broke down in tears. Speaking to Dainik Bhaskar, she said the decision has left her terrified. “These people are very powerful. The court has said to stay five kilometres away, but their men will surely come. The real danger is from them. They will destroy my family,” she said, adding that the security of witnesses in her case has already been withdrawn. “All of them are in Unnao and now they have no protection. After this decision, everyone is scared.”

Questioning the court’s order, the victim said, “A rapist and a murderer are being granted bail, but my uncle, who did nothing, has been in Tihar Jail for seven years. Kuldeep raped me. His brother killed my father, yet both are out. Why this injustice?” She also alleged that while most cases are decided within days after arguments, her case was kept pending for three months. “It’s a BJP government. He is a BJP leader, so his sentence has been suspended,” she said.

Recounting her ordeal, the survivor said she was raped by Sengar on June 4, 2017, when she went to his house in Unnao seeking a job. She alleged that she was then forcibly kept away and later tried to lodge a complaint, but the police refused to register her case. She and her mother approached several officers and even the Chief Judicial Magistrate, but got no relief.

During this period, she alleged that Sengar’s brother, Atul Singh, assaulted her father, framed him in a false case and sent him to jail. On April 9, 2018, her father died in police custody with multiple injuries. The post-mortem reportedly revealed 14 injuries on his body. Three days later, the case was transferred to the CBI.

On July 28, 2018, while the victim was travelling to Rae Bareli with her lawyer, aunt and uncle to record her statement, a truck rammed into their car, killing her aunt and uncle on the spot. The survivor and her lawyer were critically injured. The truck’s number plate was allegedly blackened. The incident led to nationwide outrage, after which the Supreme Court transferred the trial to Delhi and ordered CRPF security for the victim.

In December 2019, a Delhi court sentenced Kuldeep Sengar to life imprisonment and imposed a fine of Rs 25 lakh. He was also convicted in cases related to the victim’s father’s death.

The survivor currently lives in Delhi under CRPF protection. However, after the High Court’s order, she says she is once again living in fear. “I am worried about my family and the witnesses. We have already lost so much. I don’t want anyone else to suffer,” she said.
